versions.changelog:
English: doctor now tags every recommendation with the SV code it answers (SV___ / SV101-SV103 / SV201-SV202 / SV301 / SV303 / SV401 / SV501-SV508 / SV105), so any line in the report can be re-run with the same marker and lands on the same evidence. SKILL.md is a driver that routes to doctor and names the SV codes; references/hosts.md and references/judgment.md own the per-host evidence and the questions doctor deliberately refuses to judge. ClawHub display name is now "Skill Vitals — Skill Audit" with topics covering Skill Management, Context Management, Security Audits, Cost Optimization, Developer Tools. The internal scan.py refactor (split into the importable scripts/skill_vitals/ package) ships here with no behaviour change: golden snapshots remain byte-identical.

中文：doctor 报告里每条建议现在都带它回答的 SV 代码（SV___ / SV101–103 / SV201–202 / SV301 / SV303 / SV401 / SV501–508 / SV105），用同一 run 标记重跑能落到同一处证据。SKILL.md 仍是驱动器，指 doctor、列 SV 代码；references/hosts.md / references/judgment.md 各自负责宿主证据与 doctor 故意不判的部分。ClawHub 显示名改为「Skill Vitals — Skill Audit」，topics 覆盖 Skill Management、Context Management、Security Audits、Cost Optimization、Developer Tools。内部 scan.py 拆包（拆成 scripts/skill_vitals/ 可导入包）合入 main，行为不变，golden 快照逐字节一致。

English: Adds the doctor, explain, list, overlap, snapshot, and diff commands. doctor turns scan facts into cause, impact, and action with SV001-SV902 codes and states what it deliberately does not judge; explain reports why one skill never triggered and how to fix it. SKILL.md is now a driver that routes to those commands, with per-host evidence and judgment guidance moved into on-demand references. Internals were split from a single 3,394-line script into an importable package with no behaviour change: golden snapshots remain byte-identical. Publishing now verifies that the tag, the packaged CLI version, and the SKILL.md reference links all agree.

中文：新增 doctor、explain、list、overlap、snapshot、diff 六个命令。doctor 把扫描事实翻成「原因 → 影响 → 行动」并给出 SV001–SV902 编号，同时声明哪些它故意不判；explain 解释某个 skill 为什么没触发、怎么修。SKILL.md 改为驱动器，宿主证据与判断方法移入按需加载的 references。内部由单个 3394 行脚本拆成可导入的包，行为不变，golden 快照逐字节一致。发布流程新增校验：tag、打包后 CLI 的版本号、SKILL.md 的引用链接三者必须一致。

English: Fix Windows test isolation and UTF-8 CLI output, add Python 3.9-compatible host stubs, and verify main plus the Rust port across Windows, macOS, Linux, Cargo tests, Clippy, and Python/Rust differential tests. 中文：修复 Windows 测试环境隔离和 CLI UTF-8 输出，兼容 Python 3.9 假宿主测试，并在 Windows、macOS、Linux、Cargo test、Clippy 及 Python/Rust 差分测试中验证 main 与 Rust 重构分支。

English: Harden OpenClaw evidence handling. Separate eligible/model-visible metadata from full SKILL.md body loading, report unique runtime catalog counts per instance, fix baseline diffs across host/instance/namespace, resolve bundled Skills across npm links and pnpm layouts, and add deduplicated observed-read diagnostics explicitly labeled as indirect evidence. 中文：强化 OpenClaw 证据口径：区分模型可见元数据与完整正文加载，按实例报告唯一运行时 Skill 数，修复跨宿主/实例/命名空间 baseline diff，兼容 npm 链接和 pnpm 的内置 Skill 路径，并新增明确标记为间接证据的去重读取观测。

English: Adopt the open Agent Skills layout with a concise English SKILL.md, an on-demand complete Chinese guide, and recommended Codex/ChatGPT UI metadata. Keep the ClawHub runtime package limited to seven essential files. 中文：采用通用 Agent Skills 结构，使用精简英文主 SKILL.md、按需加载的完整中文指南，并补充 Codex/ChatGPT 推荐的 UI 元数据；ClawHub 运行包保持为七个必要文件。

English: Refresh ClawHub documentation with bilingual host compatibility guidance for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, and WorkBuddy. Publish a minimal five-file runtime bundle and enforce bilingual release notes in GitHub Actions. 中文：更新 ClawHub 中英文宿主兼容说明，覆盖 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 和 WorkBuddy；发布包精简为五个运行时文件，并在 GitHub Actions 中强制中英文更新说明。

Add evidence-aware adapters for Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, and Tencent WorkBuddy. OpenClaw now verifies eligible/model-visible skills through its structured runtime catalog, includes npm-bundled skills, isolates multiple instances, and falls back safely when the CLI is unavailable. Refresh host contracts, Rust port plan, report, and regression coverage.

Seven checks over an installed skill library: description-budget overflow (the silent failure that makes a skill vanish with no error message), context cost split into core/references/worst-case, semantic overlap, cross-level override conflicts, real trigger counts with an age gate before calling anything a zombie, structure, and supply-chain security. The script measures deterministically; judgment is the agent's job. Ships 15 regression tests, each pinning a defect that actually shipped. Note: description budget, loaded-vs-disk determination, and trigger data require Claude Code's ~/.claude.json; on other hosts they degrade to 'not available' rather than being faked. (1.0.0 was published with a placeholder changelog.)
